bindings.query: SELECT DISTINCT CAST(t.FieldTranslationFieldCategoryId AS nvarchar(100)) + N'|' + CAST(t.FieldTranslationFieldId AS nvarchar(100)) + N' = ' + CAST(t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel AS nvarchar(200)) FROM EcomProductCategoryFieldTranslation t WHERE t.FieldTranslationFieldCategoryId <> N'reference_category' AND (t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(in)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(inch%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(mm)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(cm)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(m)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(ft)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(kg)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(g)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(lb%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(oz)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(l)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(gal%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(V)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(A)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(W)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(kW)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(hp)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(bar)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(psi)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(°C)%' OR t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel LIKE N'%(°F)%')
